source_review.scope: Source-only review; coordinator owns native acceptance.
source_review.qualification: Native active paid-parent reader proves boot-load inertness only; pending/completed restoration readers exercise recovery. Actual paid Active-to-Logout native restart transition remains a distinct acceptance gap. Existing D1/P2 scope limits retained. Saved-parent acceptance uses a morph-free corpse with persisted null morph duration asserted. Ordinary morphing-corpse boot loading remains unresolved; probe-02 retains the independent failure.
source_review.followup: fm_reviewer independently verified catalogue reuse and native timer stop/save/assertion. Seven other hashes match original source clearance; no new actionable finding.

acceptance: Durable loaded children do not resolve characters or restore corpses in constructor/early Login.
Recovery waits for boot completion and exact registered owner; transient reads do not retain recurring timers; initial provider lookup failures retry.
Fresh processes load real paid parent XML after restoration commits, before and after lifecycle completion, with one exact corpse and preserved identity/body/foreign gear.
Completed stale-child cleanup preserves runtime placement and removes empty parent XML on normal save; prior timer and legacy/dispel regressions still pass.
qualification_limits: Actual paid parent/child XML is saved by native SaveManager. A real completion-update MySQL trigger refuses completion after restoration commits; producer never flushes afterward. Intermediate fresh readers deliberately leave stale XML unsaved so both pending and completed journal checkpoints can be loaded.

Native active paid-parent reader qualifies constructor and early Login inertness during blocked boot only. Actual paid Active-to-Logout restart recovery is not newly qualified; managed full-parent tests mock retirement. Prior direct-service active restart remains supporting evidence.

Saved-parent native readers use a morph-free corpse: the shared retirement fixture timer is stopped and its cached duration cleared before the paid XML save, with persisted MorphTimeRemaining=null asserted. Probe-02 independently reproduced a separate ordinary morphing-corpse boot failure in GameItem.Login -> StartMorphTimer -> HowSeen -> OriginalBody -> blocked TryGetCharacter. That pre-existing boot path remains unresolved and is not cleared by this scoped repair.

Pending and completed stale paid parents load in fresh processes; native effect scheduler recovers after exact item registration and boot. Character-blocked phase uses the actual Futuremud.TryGetCharacter boot guard. Runtime world/cell/anatomy catalogue and inherited specialized character Save remain controlled; full production boot/Telnet and native Cell.Save are not claimed.

Transient unregistered and duplicate-object reads, initial provider lookup retry and explicit loaded-parent dispel are managed checks. The native checkpoint is a controlled completion fault and quiescent processes, not simultaneous-host recovery, power loss or a cleanup race.
Current native packet reruns all 25 markers qualified at timerP2 plus eight saved-parent markers. Other 262 historical combined-packet markers are not rerun. All prior D1/C2 scope limits remain.

Installed Raise Servitor duration conversion, functional combat/control AI and native cell/save/scheduler integration under combat or queued work remain pending. No new spell families or later stock work started.

First native packet failed duplicate source-spell catalogue insertion before corpse construction; reused the existing loaded native catalogue in build03.
